core_problem_solved: To provide the standard Java Persistence API (JPA) 2.1 interfaces and annotations, as a convenience dependency bundled and published by the Hibernate project itself.
key_features: Contains the standard `javax.persistence` package and all its annotations (`@Entity`, `@Id`, etc.) and interfaces (`EntityManager`).
era_and_niche: A convenience artifact for developers using Hibernate as their JPA provider, common in the Java EE 7 era before the official API artifacts were consistently available and used from central repositories.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. Modern applications should depend on the official, vendor-neutral API artifact for Jakarta Persistence, which is **`jakarta.persistence:jakarta.persistence-api`**. Relying on a provider-specific copy of the API is a bad practice that can lead to dependency conflicts if other libraries on the classpath bring in the official API.
